atAGlance: Cà phê muối is Huế-style coffee creativity in a glass, using salted cream to make condensed-milk sweetness taste deeper and almost caramel-like.
whatItIs: Cà phê muối is Vietnamese coffee topped or mixed with salted cream. Expect salt coffee with a creamy cap, caramel-like sweetness, and a tiny salty edge that sharpens the coffee.
howToEnjoy: Sip through the salted cream instead of stirring everything flat right away.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê muối is a salted-cream coffee order, so sip through the cap before stirring. Ask less sweet if you want the salt and robusta bitterness to come forward.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê muối is tied to Huế-style café creativity and has become popular because salt makes the condensed milk taste deeper.
goodToKnow: It should taste gently salty, not briny.
